picks.title: Apatite in Chang’e-6 mare basalts reveals a heterogeneous distribution of chlorine in the Moon
picks.abstract: Chlorine (Cl) serves as a crucial volatile element, providing insight into the magmatic processes and volatile inventory of the Moon. The lunar rocks have notably elevated Cl isotopic compositions; however, no information is available about the Cl and its isotopes on the farside. Here, we report a petrographic, chemical, and Cl isotopic study of apatite in the Chang’e-6 (CE6) mare basalt collected from the South Pole–Aitken (SPA) basin. CE6 mare apatite was measured to have a Cl abundance of 0.04–3.36 wt%. We estimated a Cl abundance of ∼0.6 μg g −1 for the CE6 mantle source, slightly higher than that (0.26–0.32 μg g −1 ) estimated from Apollo low-titanium mare basalts and lower than that (∼1.3 μg g −1 ) of Chang’e-5 low-titanium mare basalt. Cl abundances in the mantle source of low-titanium mare basalts exhibit a positive correlation towards the crystallization ages, highlighting a heterogeneous distribution of chlorine in the lunar mantle. The measured chlorine isotopic compositions (δ 37 Cl, 14.5 ± 2.0‰ to 27.2 ± 2.2‰) are mostly higher than that of nearside mare basalts (0–20‰). CE6 mare apatite shows a positive correlation between Cl abundances and Cl isotopic compositions, comparable with the trend defined by the low-titanium mare apatite collected from the nearside hemisphere. We infer that the high δ 37 Cl values of CE6 mare apatite were associated with magmatic fractionation of Cl coupled with an elevated chlorine isotopes in the mantle source, favoring the model that the massive formation impact event of SPA would have imprinted the chlorine isotopic compositions in the underlying mantle rocks.
picks.summary_ja: 月の裏側・南極エイトケン盆地から採取された嫦娥6号の海の玄武岩中のアパタイトについて、岩石学・化学・塩素同位体を調べている。アパタイトのCl量は0.04–3.36 wt%で、嫦娥6号マントル源のCl量は約0.6 μg/gと推定され、アポロの低Ti玄武岩より高く嫦娥5号より低い。低Ti海玄武岩のマントル源のCl量は結晶化年代と正の相関を示し、月マントルでのClの不均質な分布を示唆する。δ37Clは14.5〜27.2‰で、多くが表側の海玄武岩(0–20‰)より高く、マグマ分別とマントル源の高いCl同位体比が関与したと推論している。
picks.why: 月サンプルリターン試料の揮発性元素分析であり、サンプル分析という点で関心に近いが、月が対象のため中程度。

picks.title: Determining post-core formation accretion in asteroid 4-Vesta and implications for inner Solar System late accretion
picks.abstract: Highly siderophile element (HSE: Re, Os, Ir, Ru, Pt, Pd) abundances are reported for eucrites, diogenites and howardites from Vesta. The four orders of magnitude variation (1 × 10 –3 to 1 × 10 –6 × CI chondrite) and measured 187 Os/ 188 Os (0.103 to 3.07) ranges in eucrites primarily reflect post-crystallization impactor additions and constrain meteorites previously identified as pristine (<1 μg/g Ni) as having limited (<0.1%) chondritic HSE additions. Pristine eucrites have fractionated inter-element HSE ratios with respect to chondrites, with a wide range of 187 Os/ 188 Os, making them distinct and more HSE-rich than lunar mare basalts. These eucrites define the crustal Vesta HSE composition as broadly similar to modern terrestrial basaltic oceanic crust. Models assuming either residual metal in the mantle, or its complete exhaustion, during eucrite melt extraction predict an HSE enriched bulk silicate Vesta compared to bulk silicate Earth or bulk silicate Mars, requiring between 0.4 to 1.9% post-core formation accretion (PCFA). A preferred alternative model using regression of the HSE to MgO contents of eucrites and diogenites derives a composition between bulk silicate Earth and bulk silicate Moon, requiring ∼0.12% PCFA. Such a composition is like the HSE contents measured for peridotites considered to come from Vesta. The estimates of PCFA from this large dataset of vestan meteorites are all higher than previously determined estimates, requiring a proportional increase in mass from leftover planetesimal and asteroidal sources to the inner Solar System planets.
picks.summary_ja: ベスタ由来のユークライト、ダイオジェナイト、ハワーダイトの高親鉄元素(HSE)存在度を報告している。ユークライトのHSEの大きな変動と187Os/188Os比は、主に結晶化後の衝突天体の付加を反映している。ベスタ地殻のHSE組成は、地球の海洋玄武岩地殻に広く似ていた。コア形成後の付加(PCFA)は、モデルにより0.4〜1.9%、またMgOとの回帰を用いた好ましいモデルでは約0.12%と見積もられ、いずれも従来推定より高い。
picks.why: 隕石に基づく初期太陽系の後期集積の研究で惑星科学として有用だが、読者の中心分野とはやや離れる。

picks.title: A new view of Xe and Ne in the Paleoarchean atmosphere from paired noble gas isotopic and trace element analyses of Barberton cherts
picks.abstract: The terrestrial atmosphere governs Earth’s habitability and remains our most accessible analogue to distant planetary atmospheres, making the evolution of its composition over Earth history a topic of great interdisciplinary scientific interest. Many different natural samples are capable of trapping and retaining atmospheric gases on billion-year timescales, providing a geochemical archive of bygone processes. These trapped gases record a progressive depletion in the abundance of xenon (Xe) accompanied by its isotopic fractionation in Earth’s Archean atmosphere. However, the detailed history of this loss and isotopic fractionation of Xe is imperfectly constrained, in part because calculations focus on the non-radiogenic light isotopes of Xe (which are the least abundant isotopes) to determine ancient atmospheric compositions. In this study, we employed the full spectrum of Xe isotopes measured in four cherts from the 3.55–3.26 Ga Onverwacht Group of the Barberton Greenstone Belt, South Africa to quantify Xe isotopic fractionation in the Paleoarchean atmosphere. First, we measured the concentration and spatial distribution of Te, Ba, U, and Th by secondary ion mass spectrometry in subsamples of each chert to estimate the expected composition of Xe produced in situ by nuclear reactions. We then analyzed chips of these subsamples for Ne, Ar, and Xe elemental and isotopic compositions. We find that Xe data from Onverwacht bulk cherts reflect mixing between Paleoarchean atmospheric Xe and modern atmospheric Xe, with minor inputs from Xe produced by U, Ba, and Te decay. A mixing model incorporating these five components and testing a range of possible Archean atmospheric compositions indicates that Xe in the ∼ 3.26–3.28 Ga atmosphere was fractionated by ≥ 19 - 3.2 + 3.1 ‰u −1 relative to modern air. Our results emphasize that even samples with noble gas compositions dominated by trapped ancient fluids may in detail reflect multicomponent mixing, and that estimates of the extent of mass-dependent Xe fractionation reported in previous studies are lower limits. Barberton chert 20 Ne/ 22 Ne ratios extend below the modern atmospheric ratio, which could reflect post-entrapment fractionation that preferentially retained heavy Ne isotopes, or may indicate the preservation of a trapped multi-component mixture including paleo-atmospheric 20 Ne/ 22 Ne that was subsequently raised by volcanic outgassing
picks.summary_ja: 南アフリカのバーバートン緑色岩帯オンバーワハト層群(3.55–3.26 Ga)の4つのチャートについて、Xe同位体の全スペクトルを用いて古始生代大気のXe同位体分別を定量化している。まず二次イオン質量分析で試料のTe、Ba、U、Thの濃度と空間分布を測り、核反応でその場生成されるXeの組成を見積もった。次にNe、Ar、Xeの元素・同位体組成を分析した。その結果、バルクチャートのXeデータは古始生代の大気成分とその場生成成分の混合を反映することが示された。
picks.why: 初期地球大気の進化はハビタビリティと関連するが、地球の太古代試料の研究であり、読者の主分野との関連は間接的。

picks.title: Incomplete lunar mantle overturn drove high-titanium volcanism 3.9–3.5 billion years ago
picks.abstract: Mantle overturn driven by the sinking of dense ilmenite-bearing cumulates (IBC) fundamentally shaped the Moon’s thermochemical evolution. Lunar high-titanium (high-Ti) volcanism directly probes this process; however, current models fail to reconcile the petrogenesis of these magmas with their highly restricted eruption window (∼3.9–3.5 Ga). Here, we use a revised thermodynamic melt model, specifically calibrated for high-Ti magmatic systems, to systematically evaluate the P – T –composition space of IBC-hybridized lunar mantle melting. Our results demonstrate that reproducing lunar high-Ti volcanic compositions requires a heavily hybridized mantle source containing ∼40–60% IBC, melting at pressures of ∼10–30 kbar (∼200–700 km depth). These moderate melting depths indicate that a substantial volume of dense IBC did not sink efficiently to the core–mantle boundary but was instead arrested and retained within the mid-to-upper mantle during the global mantle overturn. We propose that this shallow retention provides the critical framework controlling the temporal window of high-Ti volcanism. The initiation of this volcanism at ∼3.9 Ga was likely triggered by enhanced impact-driven mantle convection that mechanically facilitated the extensive source hybridization, while its cessation after ∼3.5 Ga reflects the exhaustion of these shallow IBC reservoirs alongside lunar secular cooling. Our results establish the incompleteness of the lunar mantle overturn and dynamically link it to the temporal enigmas of early high-Ti mare volcanism.
picks.summary_ja: 月の高チタン火山活動を、高チタン系に合わせて較正した熱力学的溶融モデルで評価している。高チタン火山岩の組成を再現するには、約40–60%のイルメナイト含有集積岩(IBC)を含む混成マントル源が、約10–30 kbarで溶融する必要があるとされた。この結果は、IBCの多くが核–マントル境界まで沈まず、中部〜上部マントルに留まったことを示唆する。火山活動が約3.9 Gaに始まったのは衝突駆動の対流による混成化が引き金で、約3.5 Ga以降の終息はIBC貯蔵域の枯渇と月の冷却によると提案している。
picks.why: 月内部進化の話題で惑星科学としては関連するが、読者の主関心(火星・氷衛星・アストロバイオロジー)からはやや外れる。

picks.title: Tectonic and magmatic control on hydrothermal distribution along the ultra-slow spreading Mohns Ridge
picks.abstract: Hydrothermal circulation along mid-ocean ridges is primarily controlled by the interplay between magmatic and tectonic processes. The Mohns Ridge, shaped by the Jan Mayen/Iceland plume and a shift from orthogonal to oblique accretion, provides a natural laboratory to test whether melt-flux, tectonic strain, and axial volcanic ridge (AVR) maturity predict hydrothermal venting, using a multiproxy approach combining bathymetry, magnetic, gravity, and seismicity data. Variations in mantle Bouguer anomaly and bathymetry along the axis show how plume distance and ridge obliquity jointly control melt distribution, dividing the ridge into three regions: high-melt-flux south of the 71.3°N, diffuse high-melt-flux between 71.3°N and 72.2°N, and a focused but melt-limited region northward. While AVR volume appears as an unreliable proxy for melt-flux and AVR maturity, along-axis correlation between magnetic, mantle Bouguer anomalies and sediment thickness distinguishes between well-developed active, well-developed inactive, and infrequent but recently active AVRs. Melt distribution style (focused vs. diffuse) and AVR magmatic state primarily dictate hydrothermal vent distribution: well-developed active AVR in focused regions promotes high-temperature venting, while a diffuse-melt distribution appears to hinder their development. The apparent tectonic strain in the axial valley shows no significant relationship with melt-flux or magnetic anomaly, reflecting the differing timescales between crustal accretion, alteration and surface activity. Similarly, seismic activity shows no relationship with AVR maturity, melt emplacement style, or hydrothermal venting, indicating that short-term events are decoupled from the long-term evolution of AVRs. Hydrothermal activity instead correlates more closely with the long-term magmatic evolution of AVRs than with these short-term events.
picks.summary_ja: 超低速拡大のモーンズ海嶺で、メルトフラックス、テクトニックな歪み、軸状火山海嶺(AVR)の成熟度が熱水噴出を予測できるかを、地形・磁気・重力・地震活動データで検証している。ヤンマイエン/アイスランドプルームからの距離と海嶺の斜交度が、メルト分布を3領域に分けることを示した。メルト分布様式(集中型か拡散型か)とAVRの火成活動状態が熱水噴出分布を主に支配し、集中型領域の活動的AVRで高温噴出が促されるとしている。軸谷の見かけの歪みは、メルトフラックスや磁気異常と有意な関係を示さなかった。
picks.why: 海底熱水系の研究で、アストロバイオロジー的な類推は可能だが、アブストラクトは地球の海嶺地球物理に限られ関連は薄い。
